International scholarships

All awards below are open to international students who have received an offer of admission. Applications are assessed on academic merit and all eligible applicants are considered automatically.

Flagship International Scholarship

A tuition fee reduction of 50% for the first year of study. Eligibility: international students with an offer to a postgraduate coursework degree and a GPA of 6.0 or above. Applications close 30 November.

Vice-Chancellor's Merit Scholarship

NZ$10,000 per year for up to three years. Eligible students must be commencing a bachelor degree with an ATAR of 90 or above. Apply with your admission application before the deadline.

How to apply for a scholarship

Complete the online form and attach your transcripts. Applications are reviewed weekly during the application period by the scholarships office.

Linked Award Scholarship

This award has its own page with eligibility, fee reduction details and the application deadline for each intake.
